notes.note: Weather Dopant. Differs from twin: the Memory was 'bestowed by the one I serve' (same phrasing as finished row 0.84), not planted in Methuss.
Polite variant; same English as finished row 0.68.
Clinical report voice (00/Seravee-type leader); speaker inferred.
Source calls RX 'senpai' here and in 0.72 and 0.121: a junior Rider, most likely OOO (polite). Dropped per glossary (Sempai only for Imagin to Momotaros).
Reaction rows 0.39/0.43/0.51/0.55 follow each leader block, and their tone does not always match the rescuer row before them (polite 0.41, then curt 0.43). Each is voiced from its own wording.
Source typo (dropped kana in 'dake'); read as in twin. Same for 0.78.
Town name romanized 'Yumemi Town'; not in glossary, home franchise unverified. Tower lines 0.1-0.7 are leader variants: 0.1 W (Fuuto), 0.7 Momotaros-style.
Narration; keeps twin's 'medical room' and adds the emergency treatment this version adds.
Hambrabi (Yazan) speaks 0.19-0.33. Source says 'Regis', not twin's 'Regis Core', in 0.21/0.22, and uses the short name 'Zeta' in 0.23/0.33.
Cry from Hambrabi's minions; romanized 'Veh-veh!!' (no established spelling).
Maganac, annoyed that more than one person came when asked to come alone.

rows.en: You bastard, you lured us here on purpose!!
This is the Invisible Memory. A special Memory bestowed upon me by the one I serve.
Now, what happens when I use it...? Ah, but you already know, don't you!?
I've tried every Memory there is, and even I am amazed by this one!!
I'll hit you with my special attack, Part 2!!
We're getting nowhere like this! Fall back for now!
...Yeah, but you got any way to pull that off?
No clue what that is, but let's bet on it!!
Hikari is repairing it for us! Let's hurry back to the base!
Unidentified object confirmed. Life signs inside!?
Who is it? Who's in there...
Kamen Rider Black RX...
Ah... RX!? Are you all right!?
I'll save you right now!!
Kamen Rider Black RX!?
That you, RX!? What the hell happened to ya, stuck in a place like that!!
All right, hang tight!! I'm gonna get ya outta there!!
All right, I'll save you now!!
A Kamen Rider!? Then you're not an enemy...
I'll save you right now!!
A Kamen Rider...? So you're one of our comrades as well.
A Kamen Rider!? Then you're one of our comrades!
Are you all right!? Hang on!! I'll save you right now!!
A Kamen Rider!? Then that makes you one of our comrades, right?
I can't believe it... I was pulled into this world and, to my shame, captured by the enemy.
But my body's all right... Don't worry.
But, RX, at this rate...
But we can't just leave you like this.
But still, it's rough on me too, not bein' able to do a thing!!
But at this rate, you'll only wear yourself down.
But at this rate, you'll only wear yourself down.
That's right...! There's something I have to tell you all.
Until just a moment ago, Kamen Rider 1 and Kamen Rider 2 were here, frozen in ice.
I want to save them. But in my current state...
Do you know where they were taken!?
Hmm... when you say they took 'em, took 'em where?
Still, where'd they haul 'em off to?
Where in the world could they have taken them...
Huh? Hideout Cube...? Doesn't sound like it's this Cube.
I thought I'd be the next one they took away, but The O had other plans...
He's set his sights on the "King Stone" inside my body.
The King Stone is the power of miracles. It must never, ever fall into enemy hands...
But what about you...?
Forget that, is your body even okay? You look like you're hurtin' bad.
See, what'd I tell ya!! You alright!?
...I'm fine. I'm just short on sunlight...
I can't bring out my true power, but it's nothing that'll kill me.
We'll defeat The O, I promise!!
Ya sure? Don't go actin' all tough, y'hear?
Anyway, leave The O to us, and you just wait right here!
Leave The O to us!
Leave The O to us!
Leave The O to us!
Leave The O to us!
Please leave The O to us!
Leave The O to us!
That tower... how tall is that thing? There was nothing like that in Fuuto.
That tower sure is tall... There wasn't anything like that in Yumemi Town, was there?
What's that tower? At that rate, it looks like it could reach all the way to space.
What's that tower...? It's tall. Does it reach all the way to space?
That tower... it's so tall! I can't even see the top!!
What's that tower...? It looks incredibly tall...
The hell? What's with that tower! Bein' tall don't make you a big shot!!
Once they reached the base, RX was rushed to the medical room for emergency treatment.
But it's walls everywhere in there. Was there even anywhere we could explore?
Word is an MS hunting Zeta Gundam has appeared in Desert Cube's Quicksand Zone. Investigate.
Never seen an MS like that before... Yeah, it went off past this quicksand.
Well, well!! Found ya!! Zeta Gundam!! Hell, you even came right to me!!
Thanks to you, I got run out of Regis and stuck in a dump like this, miserable and filthy!!
Bring you back as a gift, and my name's cleared! I can stroll back into Regis, head held high!!
All right, you lot! Seize Zeta!! There's a cash bonus if you pull it off!!
Veh-veh!!
You wanna go!? It ain't gonna go like last time!!
Dammit!! Retreat!! But don't think this is over!!
What!? You lot... Zeta ain't with you!?
You came to hear my request? I'm pretty sure I said to come alone!?
Hyahhahhahhah!! It's around here, right!?
Hm...? What's with you guys?
...You mole bastards!! That's our weapon buried there!!
